pairs: Then he arrived at Derbe and Lystra.
Et ecce discipulus quidam erat ibi nomine Timotheus,
a certain disciple named Timothy was there,
the son of a faithful Jewish woman,
Huic testimonium bonum reddebant qui in Lystris erant et Iconio fratres.
The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium rendered good testimony to him.
Paul wanted this man to travel with him,
et assumens circumcidit eum propter Judæos qui erant in illis locis.
and taking him, he circumcised him, because of the Jews who were in those places.
Sciebant enim omnes quod pater ejus erat gentilis.
For they all knew that his father was a Gentile.
And as they were traveling through the cities,
tradebant eis custodiri dogmata quæ erant decreta ab Apostolis
they delivered to them the dogmas to be kept,
which were decreed by the Apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.
the Churches were being strengthened in faith and were increasing in number every day.
while crossing through Phrygia and the region of Galatia,
vetati sunt a Spiritu Sancto loqui verbum Dei in Asia.
they were prevented by the Holy Spirit from speaking the Word in Asia.
But when they had arrived in Mysia,
they attempted to go into Bithynia,
et non permisit eos Spiritus Jesu.
but the Spirit of Jesus would not permit them.
Then, when they had crossed through Mysia,
et visio per noctem Paulo ostensa est: vir Macedo quidam erat stans et deprecans eum,
And a vision in the night was revealed to Paul of a certain man of Macedonia, standing and pleading with him,
Then, after he saw the vision,
immediately we sought to set out for Macedonia,
certi facti quod vocasset nos Deus evangelizare eis.
having been assured that God had called us to evangelize to them.
taking a direct path, we arrived at Samothrace,
and on the following day, at Neapolis,
quæ est prima partis Macedoniæ civitas,
which is the preeminent city in the area of Macedonia,
Eramus autem in hac urbe diebus aliquot,
Now we were in this city some days,
Die autem sabbatorum egressi sumus foras portam juxta flumen,
Then, on the Sabbath day, we were walking outside the gate,
beside a river, where there seemed to be a prayer gathering.
et sedentes loquebamur mulieribus quæ convenerant.
And sitting down, we were speaking with the women who had assembled.
And a certain woman, named Lydia,
a seller of purple in the city of Thyatira,
cujus Dominus aperuit cor intendere his quæ dicebantur a Paulo.
And the Lord opened her heart to be receptive to what Paul was saying.
And when she had been baptized,
Si judicastis me fidelem Domino esse,
“If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord,
Factum est autem euntibus nobis ad orationem,
Then it happened that, as we were going out to prayer,
puellam quamdam habentem spiritum pythonem obviare nobis,
a certain girl, having a spirit of divination, met with us.
quæ quæstum magnum præstabat dominis suis divinando.
She was a source of great profit to her masters, through her divining.
This girl, following Paul and us,
Isti homines servi Dei excelsi sunt,
“These men are servants of the Most High God!
They are announcing to you the way of salvation!”
Now she behaved in this way for many days.
turned and said to the spirit,
Præcipio tibi in nomine Jesu Christi exire ab ea.
“I command you, in the name of Jesus Christ, to go out from her.”
And it went away in that same hour.
Videntes autem domini ejus quia exivit spes quæstus eorum,
seeing that the hope of their profit went away,
and they brought them to the rulers at the courthouse.
And presenting them to the magistrates,
et annuntiant morem quem non licet nobis suscipere neque facere,
And they are announcing a way which is not lawful for us to accept or to observe,
And the people rushed together against them.
ordered them to be beaten with staffs.
Et cum multas plagas eis imposuissent,
And when they had inflicted many scourges on them,
præcipientes custodi ut diligenter custodiret eos.
instructing the guard to watch them diligently.
And since he had received this kind of order,
he cast them into the interior prison cell,
and he restricted their feet with stocks.
in the middle of the night,
Paul and Silas were praying and praising God.
et audiebant eos qui in custodia erant.
And those who were also in custody were listening to them.
Subito vero terræmotus factus est magnus,
Yet truly, there was a sudden earthquake,
so great that the foundations of the prison were moved.
Et statim aperta sunt omnia ostia:
And immediately all the doors were opened,
and the bindings of everyone were released.
Then the prison guard, having been jarred awake,
and seeing the doors of the prison open,
drew his sword and intended to kill himself,
supposing that the prisoners had fled.
But Paul cried out with a loud voice,
he fell before the feet of Paul and Silas.
so that I may be saved?”
and then you will be saved,
Et locuti sunt ei verbum Domini cum omnibus qui erant in domo ejus.
And they spoke the Word of the Lord to him, along with all those who were in his house.
Et tollens eos in illa hora noctis,
And he, taking them in the same hour of the night,
Cumque perduxisset eos in domum suam,
And when he had brought them into his own house,
he set a table for them.
et lætatus est cum omni domo sua credens Deo.
And he was joyous, with his entire household, believing in God.
Nuntiavit autem custos carceris verba hæc Paulo:
But the prison guard reported these words to Paul:
“The magistrates have sent to have you released.
Paulus autem dixit eis: Cæsos nos publice,
But Paul said to them: “They have beaten us publicly,
indemnatos homines Romanos, miserunt in carcerem:
though we were not condemned. They have cast men who are Romans into prison.
And now they would drive us away secretly?
and let us drive them away.”
Nuntiaverunt autem magistratibus lictores verba hæc.
Then the attendants reported these words to the magistrates.
And upon hearing that they were Romans, they were afraid.
And arriving, they pleaded with them,
et educentes rogabant ut egrederentur de urbe.
and leading them out, they begged them to depart from the city.
And they went away from the prison and entered into the house of Lydia.
